title: Audit Round-Count Calibration via Convergence-Saturation Signal
summary: Default audit round count is 3; rounds 4 and 5 fire only when the convergence-saturation signal (P1 = 0, P2-new <= 1, no new framings) has not triggered; rounds beyond 5 need practitioner authorization. Form-change events reset the round-count baseline.

links.note: Skill-Structure Layer application at audit-round-end; the verdict line is the audit-bearing artifact
same tier, distinct workflow point: round-count calibration at audit-round-end versus loop termination at research-loop-end
